Visit note | 2025-09-18 03:30 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Ibrahim Akand, 32, male. Mr. Akand returns for review, reporting persistent wheezing and a tight chest in dust or cold air, which flared during the winter smog in Tejgaon. He works as a graphic designer. He continues to take his regular treatment. Comorbidity: Hypothyroidism. He denies fever, nocturnal cough spells, or breathlessness at rest.
